list.title: Projects
list.subtitle: Planned changes, improvements and design work, with their milestones, team, reviews and lessons learned.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search projects by code or title
list.timelineEmpty: None of these projects has a start or due date yet, so there is nothing to draw.

form.teamHint: Add the people who will work on the project. You become a manager automatically as the owner, and you can change the team later.
form.changeReasonHint: Saved in the revision history so others can see why the project changed.
form.readOnly: You can view this project but not edit it. The owner, a team manager or a project administrator can.
form.closedReadOnly: This project is closed. Reopen it to make changes.
form.assistBody: Describe the project in a sentence or two and the assistant proposes the title, objective, scope and dates. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

errors.dueBeforeStart: The due date cannot be before the start date.

detail.noSecurityReqs: No information security requirements written down yet.
detail.closedNotice: This project is {{ status }} (closed on {{ date }} by {{ name }}). It is read-only; lessons learned can still be added.
detail.deleteMessage: {{ code }} is removed together with its milestones, design reviews and lessons, and its open tasks are cancelled. The audit trail is kept.

plan.title: Plan
plan.empty: Nothing is scheduled yet. Add phases and milestones with dates, or tasks with due dates, to see the plan.

board.empty: No tasks yet. Add tasks on the Tasks tab or on a milestone.
board.moveFailed: The task could not be moved. Check that you may edit it and try again.

milestones.title: Phases and milestones
milestones.empty: No phases or milestones yet. Split the work into phases, and mark the points where something must be finished or decided as milestones.
milestones.deleteMessage: "{{ title }}" is removed from the plan. Its open tasks are cancelled.

reviews.title: Design reviews, verification and validation
reviews.empty: No reviews recorded yet. Plan a review at each important stage, and record verification (does the output meet the input requirements?) and validation (does it work for the intended use?).
reviews.needsDate: Give the date the review was held before recording an outcome.
reviews.deleteMessage: "{{ title }}" is removed. The audit trail is kept.

lessons.title: Lessons learned
lessons.empty: No lessons recorded yet. Note what went well and what should be done differently next time, while it is fresh.

team.title: Team
team.removeMessage: {{ name }} is removed from the project team. Their tasks stay assigned to them.

closeout.title: Close {{ code }}
closeout.subtitle: Record how the project ended and what you learned.

outcomeHints.completed: The objective was reached. Every milestone, design review and task must be finished first.
outcomeHints.cancelled: The project is stopped. Open tasks are cancelled.

closeout.openItems: The project still has open work: {{ milestones }} milestones, {{ reviews }} pending design reviews and {{ tasks }} open tasks. Finish or cancel them, or close the project as cancelled.
closeout.lessonsHint: Lessons without a title are skipped. You can add more after closing.

reopen.title: Reopen {{ code }}?
reopen.message: The project becomes active again and can be edited. Say why it is reopened; the reason is kept in the history.

ai.title: AI help
ai.intro: Get a status summary for a steering group, or prompts for risks the project may face. Check the output before you use it.
ai.checkNote: Generated from the project's records. Check it before you share it.
ai.taskFailed: The task could not be added.
ai.risksNote: Suggestions only. Register the real risks in the risk register and link them to the project on the Related tab.

ask.summarise: Summarise this project: where it stands, what is late and what needs a decision.
ask.objective: Help me write a clear, measurable objective for this project.
ask.objectiveReview: Is this project objective clear and measurable? Suggest improvements.
ask.securityRequirements: Which information security requirements should this project consider (ISO 27001 A.5.8)?
ask.findings: Help me write clear findings and actions for this design review.
ask.draft: Help me set up a new project. Ask me what it is about, then draft it for me to confirm.
ask.draftLabel: Draft a project with the assistant
